prompt.es: Responde al oyente (115-240 palabras): malentendido, corrección y tema nuevo.

answer.text: Hello, and thank you for your message. I think there is a misunderstanding about our segment. What the guest actually said was that phones can be useful tools, not that they are always good. In fact, she admitted that some students get distracted, and she suggested using phones only for clear tasks. She also recommended a three-month test. To be fair, you are right about one thing: the host thinks that a ban is easier to control. So, to sum up, the guest and the host have different stances, but nobody claimed that a ban is never a good idea. By the way, I propose a segment about homework next week, because you asked for it. Thank you for listening.
